title: CNN, Axios and other publishers join Google's AI news program
key_facts: CNN struck a multiyear content partnership with Google giving it expanded rights to CNN journalism and IP across its AI products
CNN is compensated; terms were not disclosed and it is unclear which Google products will use the content
Google says more than 400 publications worldwide now take part in its News AI pilot, launched in December 2025
Newest partners include Axios, CNN, The Financial Times, Forbes, and US local outlets such as Post and Courier and Texas Tribune
Google pays participants for delivery and use of enhanced content to build AI features
Features include article overviews on Google News publisher pages and customizable audio briefings, with attribution and links
quote_evidence: CNN has struck a multiyear content partnership with Google to allow the tech giant to use more of its journalism and intellectual property across its artificial intelligence products, the two organizations announced Thursday.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, and it is unclear which Google products would use CNN's content.
Through this licensing program, we pay participating news publications for the delivery and use of enhanced content to develop new AI features.
why_it_matters_hint: News publishers get paid for AI use of their reporting.
